description: Election Commission - A member of the Muthur Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Muthur Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under electoral processes and local government election matters, specifically fitting Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with changes in elected office holders under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
